description: Mitigations for struck-by events (falling objects, projectiles, swinging loads). Head protection is the dominant control.

mitigations.name: toe_board_netting
mitigations.description: Scaffold toe boards (EN 12811) and debris netting prevent objects falling from height to workers below. Collective protection — protects everyone in the zone.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.05. Passive engineered. Failure: incomplete coverage, gaps at edges, netting damaged, toe boards not installed on all levels.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Prevents small objects (tools, fittings, debris) from falling. Not effective against large objects that can break through netting.

mitigations.name: tool_lanyard
mitigations.description: Tools tethered to worker or structure to prevent dropping. Eliminates the dropped-object hazard at source.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.15. Human-dependent — worker must clip the lanyard. Similar compliance challenge to fall arrest harness.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: When tethered, tool cannot fall to workers below. Near-complete elimination of that specific dropped-object hazard.

mitigations.name: hard_hat
mitigations.description: Industrial safety helmet absorbing and distributing impact force. EN 397 rated to 5kg from 1m (49J). The primary PPE for struck-by head protection.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.08. Failure modes: not worn (most common), worn incorrectly (not fastened), damaged/expired shell, impact exceeds rating.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: EN 397 test: survives 49J impact without transmitting >5kN to head. Distributes force over larger area. Reduces skull fracture probability significantly but cannot prevent all head injuries from heavy objects. P50=0.60 reflects that hard hats prevent ~60% of the severity of impacts within their rating.

mitigations.name: exclusion_zone
mitigations.description: Barriered zone preventing personnel from entering the drop zone below overhead work. Physical barriers + signage + banksman.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.15. Managed control — requires barriers to be set up and maintained, personnel to comply. Failure: barriers moved, shortcut through zone, zone not extended far enough.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: If no one is in the drop zone, falling objects cannot strike anyone. Effectiveness limited by zone size calculation and compliance.

mitigations.name: crane_lift_plan
mitigations.description: Formal lift plan for crane operations: load calculation, exclusion zone, banksman, communication protocol. Administrative control ensuring competent execution.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Reduces probability of load drop and ensures exclusion zone during lift. Does not physically prevent the drop — effectiveness is indirect.
